sentences.en: There was a provision in his will for his mistress.
sentences.zh: 在他的遗嘱中有一项条款是给他的情妇的。

sentences.en: They took enough provisions for three years at sea.
sentences.zh: 他们带足了三年航海所需的补给。

sentences.en: You're going to run out of provisions before you get there.
sentences.zh: 你到了那里之前会把物资用光的。
